summary: Receives local shared-memory textures from Spout on Windows or Syphon on macOS.

key_params.name: usespoutactivesender
key_params.note: Use the global Spout Active Sender instead of Sender Name.

common_gotchas: Spout on Windows requires an Nvidia or AMD GPU; Intel-only does not work.
Shared memory works only on the same computer and does not send textures over the network.
Use Spout Active Sender overrides the Sender Name parameter.
Windows Spout defaults to a 10-sender limit unless the registry setting is changed.
key_concepts: Syphon Spout In receives texture images through local shared memory from Spout or Syphon senders.
Spout is the Windows path and Syphon is the macOS path; this is not a network transport.
Use Spout Active Sender can override the explicit Sender Name.
Network alternatives are Touch In/Out TOP or NDI In/Out TOP.
